description: Use to estimate depreciation: median price by model year with year-on-year change, plus price change per 10,000 km. Needs at least 5 listings; otherwise returns 404 and you are not charged. Use market_stats instead for a simple market overview without depreciation calculations. Costs 0.01 USDC per call via x402; no-data results are free.

country.description: Market to query: IE = Ireland (default), GB = UK including Northern Ireland, ALL = both. Prices are always also given in EUR (GBP converted at the live ECB rate).

fuel_type.description: Optional: restrict to one fuel type.
